description: test/support/materializer/olivine/reading_test_helpers.ex reimplements Reading's private logic (execute_get, fetch_from_page, do_now_or_async_with_reply...). Tests using it (key_selector_test.exs, logic_test.exs) exercise the copy, not the module — this masked the sync-path Process.monitor crash fixed in PR #79. Migrate callers to the real Reading public API (reading_test.exs shows the pattern), then delete or shrink the helper.
title: Migrate olivine tests off ReadingTestHelpers duplication
